meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'this, it (is)', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'овершенно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: That is completely normal.

examples.text: Совершенно верно, я мэр этого города.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('pregnant').

examples.text: Я была беременна и всё забывала.
examples.trans: I was pregnant and kept forgetting everything.

meanings.en: once, on one occasion, one day

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'came', paired with 'приходить'.

examples.trans: Security will be here any moment.
